# CS6515 — Graduate Algorithms

> Week-based course notes, algorithm references, and lecture transcripts.

## Complete course sources
- [Course source](https://dariennouri.github.io/cs6515-github-pages/course-source.html): all distinct lessons/transcripts in static HTML.
- [Plain-text course source](https://dariennouri.github.io/cs6515-github-pages/course-source.txt): downloadable UTF-8 text with source URLs.
- [Content directory](https://dariennouri.github.io/cs6515-github-pages/content-index.html): all page and PDF links, plus import instructions.
- [Manifest](https://dariennouri.github.io/cs6515-github-pages/content-manifest.json): source paths, URLs, content hashes, and duplicates.
